tools.name: calculate_marketplace_fees
tools.description: Computes selling fees, net profit, margin and ROI for one sale on Amazon, eBay or Etsy from the sale price, shipping and costs. tools.name: lookup_barcode
tools.description: Finds product details (title, brand, category, image, description) for a UPC, EAN or GTIN barcode, using open product catalogs (strong for UK/EU groceries, drinks and cosmetics). Free.

tools.name: generate_qr_code
tools.description: Generates a QR code image (PNG) or SVG markup for any text or URL, e.g. for packaging inserts, product labels or invoices. Free.

tools.description: Checks a job created by one of the image tools. Returns download_url once it is unlocked (API-key jobs are paid up front; anonymous ones by a human via unlock_url).
